name: Aeey Choti Choti Baatein Pakadne Lag Gaya Tu Chotu
visual_description: Akshay Kumar pinching the chin/cheek of a boy in blue pajamas while talking, with an older man sitting nearby.
usage_context: Used to playfully or sarcastically dismiss someone who points out trivial mistakes, petty details, or minor discrepancies.

example.top_text: When your friend points out a minor flaw in your exaggerated story
